entry.title: Coatue's Hedge Fund Sees Worst Drop in More Than a Year
entry.summary: Coatue Management’s hedge fund plunged 8.3% last month, marking the latest tech-focused money manager to be whipsawed after a sharp selloff in AI stocks, though sources say the fund is still up 14.3% year-to-date. Bloomberg's Hema Parmar joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)
